dex.entry: The apex gust-fox — a lithe, white-silver predator whose tail is now a visible thunderstorm compressed into a spinning cylinder; at full sprint its approach sounds like a breaking gale. The little kit that couldn't quite leave the ground became this magnificent silver storm-predator.
